cohort: The study describes a 9-year-old intact female domestic shorthair queen experiencing dystocia and cardiopulmonary arrest, and her two kittens.
finding: Perimortem Cesarean section successfully delivered and led to the resuscitation of two kittens following maternal cardiopulmonary arrest.
mod_finding: Perimortem Cesarean section was demonstrated as a successful mode of birth for neonates following maternal cardiopulmonary arrest, resulting in the successful resuscitation and long-term survival of two kittens.
